title: Turn received peace into praise
summary: Received peace stays alive through Bani, praise, and steady Naam. Release becomes possible when return matters more than replay.
takeaway: Release becomes possible when return matters more than replay.
lifeApplication: When the old sentence rises again, release it before it claims the room and choose one softer answer instead of replay.

source.shortMeaning: Received peace stays alive through Bani, praise, and steady Naam.
source.lifeApplication: When relief arrives, speak Bani before the old replay starts again.

evidence.coreClaim: Received peace stays alive through Bani, praise, and steady Naam.
evidence.turn: Remember this: received forgiveness becomes lasting peace when it ripens into Naam.
evidence.practicalImplication: When the old sentence rises again, release it before it claims the room and choose one softer answer instead of replay.
